# Warren

> Warren is an AI-powered financial advisor platform that democratizes financial guidance through intelligent analysis and personalized recommendations across saving, investing, taxes, and debt management.

Warren provides a completely free financial advisory platform leveraging AI agents to deliver personalized financial guidance. The platform combines intelligent advisors with comprehensive financial education resources, real-time market data, and security features including AES-256 encryption and regulatory compliance.

## Key Topics

- AI Financial Advisor
- Personal Finance
- Retirement Planning
- Investment Advice
- Debt Management
- Tax Optimization
- Budgeting Tools
- Wealth Management
- 401(k) and Roth IRA
- High-Yield Savings Accounts
- Index Funds
- 50/30/20 Budget Rule
- Bank-Level Security
- GDPR/CCPA Compliance
- Free Financial Platform
